summary: Question 4.3 asks, for given $n$ and $r$, for the smallest $s$ such that $f(n,r,s)=g(n,r,s)$. The paper separates the functions for $s\ll\sqrt{r}/\log r$ and proves agreement for $s\geq\sqrt{r\log r}$, leaving the crossover open. No follow-up resolving it was found in the May 2026 review.
